subject: science
concept: Understanding Newton's First Law: an object in motion (or at rest) stays that way unless acted on by a force
source_inspiration: adapted from NGSS Physical Science Disciplinary Core Ideas (Forces and Motion) — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student observes a rolling object continue until friction or a barrier stops it, in a real or simulated setup
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a described scenario to whether Newton's First Law explains the object's behavior
exercise.abstract: Student explains a given scenario using Newton's First Law (inertia)

misconception_flags: believes a moving object needs a continuous force just to keep moving at constant velocity

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
